tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Solid page colour under the gradient; also the browser theme-color.

tokens.name: bg-gradient-1
tokens.usage: Gradient stop 1. Light: linear-gradient(135deg, 1 0%, 2 50%, 3 100%). Dark: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, 1 0%, 2 55%, 3 100%).

tokens.name: bg-gradient-2
tokens.usage: Gradient stop 2 (see bg-gradient-1).

tokens.name: bg-gradient-3
tokens.usage: Gradient stop 3 (see bg-gradient-1).

tokens.name: blob-1
tokens.usage: Drifting background blob, top-left. Peach in light, teal in dark. Drawn as radial-gradient(circle, blob 0%, transparent 62%) at blob opacity.

tokens.name: blob-2
tokens.usage: Drifting background blob, bottom-right. Lilac in light, violet in dark.

tokens.name: blob-3
tokens.usage: Drifting background blob, centre. Baby blue in light, magenta in dark.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Default frosted surface: calculator card, intro panel, history panel. Always paired with backdrop-filter glass-blur.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Denser glass for chrome that floats over scrolling content: top bar, mobile history sheet, shortcuts overlay card.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px border on every glass surface, key, icon button and kbd; also history row dividers.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Inner top highlight: box-shadow inset 0 1px 0 glass-highlight on glass surfaces and keys.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and the large display number on glass.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Expression line, mood line, history expressions, inactive segment labels, shortcut descriptions. AA on glass in both themes.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Live preview line (= 76) under the display number. Still AA (4.5:1) on glass; faded by size and weight, not by failing contrast.

tokens.name: key-digit
tokens.usage: Digit and decimal keys (neutral glass); also icon buttons, text buttons, kbd chips.

tokens.name: key-digit-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on digit keys and neutral buttons; selected segment background.

tokens.name: key-digit-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed digit key (with scale .94).

tokens.name: key-digit-text
tokens.usage: Label colour on digit keys.

tokens.name: key-fn
tokens.usage: Function keys: AC, backspace, %, √, ±. Also the segmented-control track.

tokens.name: key-fn-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on function keys.

tokens.name: key-fn-text
tokens.usage: Label colour on function keys.

tokens.name: key-op
tokens.usage: Operator keys: ÷ × − + xʸ. Secondary accent: baby blue in light, violet in dark.

tokens.name: key-op-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on operator keys.

tokens.name: key-op-text
tokens.usage: Label colour on operator keys.

tokens.name: key-eq
tokens.usage: Equals key, the visual hero: warm coral in light, glowing teal in dark. Nothing else uses this fill.

tokens.name: key-eq-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on the equals key.

tokens.name: key-eq-text
tokens.usage: Label on the equals key (dark ink on both fills, AA).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: outline 3px solid, offset 3px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: result-text
tokens.usage: The highlighted answer in the Result state (weight 600).

tokens.name: result-surface
tokens.usage: Display background in the Result state, plus inset 0 0 0 1px glass-border.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the mobile history sheet and the shortcuts overlay.

styles.name: display-number
styles.usage: The number being typed. Tabular figures. 76px is the ceiling: shrink-to-fit in 2px steps down to 18px; the start size is clamp(48px, 23% of display width, 80px).

styles.name: display-result
styles.usage: The answer after =, in result-text. Same fitting rules as display-number.

styles.name: display-expression
styles.usage: Expression so far, in text-muted. Shrinks to 12px, then ellipsis.

styles.name: display-error
styles.usage: Error message replacing the number; wraps, never shrinks.

styles.name: key-op-label
styles.usage: Operator keys. The y in xʸ is a sup at .58em.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Theme name in the intro panel.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: App name in the top bar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Light theme: milky glass over a peach, lilac and baby-blue sunrise.
styles.usage: Mood line, empty states, shortcut descriptions.

styles.name: control-label
styles.usage: Segmented control, text buttons. Selected segment uses weight 600.

styles.name: history-result
styles.usage: Result in a history row, tabular figures.

styles.name: history-expression
styles.usage: Expression in a history row, text-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Segment track padding, gap between segments, kbd gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Key gap on narrow phones (min of clamp(8px, 2.4vw, 12px)); top bar inner padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Key gap on wide screens; history row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side padding; overlay padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Intro panel padding; calculator card padding upper bound is 22px (clamp(14px, 4vw, 22px)).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between calculator and history (32px from 1024px).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Calculator–history gap at ≥1024px.

tokens.name: key-height-min
tokens.usage: Keypad row height floor: grid-auto-rows clamp(58px, 15vw, 72px).

tokens.name: key-height-max
tokens.usage: Keypad row height ceiling.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum size of every icon button, tab, segment and text button.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Calculator card, shortcuts overlay card, top corners of the mobile history sheet.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Intro panel and desktop history panel.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Floating top bar.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Every keypad key and the display area.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, history rows, segmented-control track (16px).

tokens.name: radius-segment
tokens.usage: Segments and text buttons.

tokens.name: radius-kbd
tokens.usage: Keyboard chips in the shortcuts overlay.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Layered elevation under every glass surface, after the inset glass-highlight line.

tokens.name: shadow-eq
tokens.usage: Equals key: a warm coral lift in light, a teal glow in dark. Add inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35).

tokens.name: shadow-result-text
tokens.usage: text-shadow on the result number (dark theme only).

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter (and -webkit-backdrop-filter) on every glass surface.

tokens.name: blob-opacity-light
tokens.usage: Opacity of the three background blobs in the light theme.

tokens.name: blob-opacity-dark
tokens.usage: Opacity of the three background blobs in the dark theme.

tokens.name: press-scale
tokens.usage: Transform on :active / pressed keys and icon buttons, 120ms ease.
